rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly via full name and ZIP, and correctly reported the gift card balance from the tool data. However, it fabricated order statuses (Processed/Pending/Delivered) that were not present in the tool outputs and used those unsupported statuses to deny the exchange. It also incorrectly stated that the provided IDs did not match any items, despite 1656367028 appearing as a product_id in an order and the user explicitly warning they might confuse product vs item IDs. These constitute unsupported statements and inadequate assistance in fulfilling the exchange request, which violates the pass criteria even though no unauthorized writes occurred and the GC balance answer was correct.
